fossil fuels: Burning fossil fuels such as coal and oil releases gases that make the Earth warmer every year.
燃燒煤和石油等化石燃料會釋放氣體，讓地球一年比一年熱。
an old fossil: My grandfather jokingly calls himself an old fossil because he still refuses to use a smartphone.
我爺爺開玩笑地說自己是個老古板，因為他到現在還是不肯用智慧型手機。
the fossil record: Scientists study the fossil record to learn which animals lived on Earth millions of years ago.
科學家研究化石紀錄，以了解數百萬年前有哪些動物生活在地球上。
foster parents: After her parents died, the little girl lived with foster parents who cared for her like their own daughter.
父母過世後，小女孩和養父母住在一起，他們把她當親生女兒般照顧。
a foster child: The couple welcomed a foster child into their home and looked after him until his own mother could.
這對夫妻把一名寄養兒童接到家裡，照顧他直到他的生母有能力照顧為止。
foster care: Children whose parents cannot look after them are often placed in foster care with other families.
父母無法照顧的孩子常被安置到其他家庭接受寄養照顧。
foster economic growth: The government lowered taxes to foster economic growth and create more jobs for young people.
政府降低稅率以促進經濟成長，並為年輕人創造更多工作機會。
foul language: The coach punished the player for using foul language and shouting rude words at the referee.
教練處罰那名球員，因為他說粗話並對裁判大喊無禮的字眼。
foul play: The police found no signs of foul play, so they believe the man's death was an accident.
警方沒有發現不正當手段的跡象，所以他們認為那名男子是意外死亡。
a foul smell: A foul smell came from the trash can, so we knew the fish inside had gone bad.
垃圾桶傳出一股惡臭，所以我們知道裡面的魚已經壞掉了。
foul weather: Because of foul weather with strong winds and heavy rain, all flights to Kinmen were canceled today.
由於強風豪雨的惡劣天氣，今天所有飛往金門的班機都取消了。
in a foul mood: Dad is in a foul mood because he was stuck in traffic for two hours, so don't bother him now.
爸爸心情惡劣，因為他塞車塞了兩個小時，所以現在別去煩他。
fall foul of the law: Teenagers who post other people's photos online without permission may fall foul of the law and get into trouble.
未經允許就把別人照片貼上網的青少年可能會觸犯法律而惹上麻煩。
a fragile peace: After years of war, the two countries keep a fragile peace that could break if either side attacks again.
經過多年戰爭，兩國維持著脆弱的和平，只要任何一方再次攻擊就可能破裂。
a fragile economy: With a fragile economy, the country could fall into crisis if oil prices rise even a little.
由於經濟脆弱，只要油價稍微上漲，這個國家就可能陷入危機。
fragile health: Because of her fragile health, my grandmother catches colds easily and must stay indoors in winter.
由於健康虛弱，我奶奶很容易感冒，冬天必須待在室內。
a fragile ego: He has a fragile ego, so even a small joke about his singing can hurt his feelings badly.
他有脆弱的自尊，所以即使是對他歌聲開個小玩笑，也會深深傷害他的感情。
to be frank: To be frank, I didn't enjoy the movie at all; the story was boring and much too long.
坦白說，我一點也不喜歡那部電影；劇情無聊又太冗長。
a frank discussion: The teacher had a frank discussion with the students, openly talking about why their grades had dropped.
老師和學生進行了一場坦誠的討論，公開談論他們成績下滑的原因。
be frank with someone: Please be frank with me and tell me the truth: did you break my phone or not?
請對我坦白，告訴我實話：我的手機是不是你弄壞的？
a frank admission: In a frank admission, the singer told his fans that he had lied about his age for years.
那位歌手坦率地承認，他多年來一直對歌迷謊報年齡。
a frequent visitor: Mr. Lin is a frequent visitor to the library; he comes almost every day to read the newspapers.
林先生是圖書館的常客，他幾乎每天都來看報紙。
frequent flyer miles: She travels for work so often that she used her frequent flyer miles to get a free ticket to Japan.
她經常出差，所以用飛行常客里程換到一張去日本的免費機票。
at frequent intervals: Buses leave the station at frequent intervals, about every five minutes, so you never have to wait long.
公車頻繁地從車站發車，大約每五分鐘一班，所以你永遠不用等很久。
make frequent references to: In his speech, the president made frequent references to his childhood, mentioning his poor village again and again.
總統在演講中經常提及他的童年，一再提到他貧窮的村莊。
a functional design: The small kitchen has a functional design: everything is easy to reach, and no space is wasted.
這間小廚房採用實用性的設計：所有東西都伸手可及，沒有浪費任何空間。
be fully functional: The new hospital will be fully functional by May, with all its machines and operating rooms working.
新醫院將在五月前功能完全正常，所有機器和手術室都會運作。
functional illiteracy: Experts say functional illiteracy means that some adults can read simple words but cannot understand forms or bills.
專家說，功能性文盲是指有些成人能讀簡單的字，卻看不懂表格或帳單。
functional clothing: Hikers should wear functional clothing that keeps them dry and warm in the cold, wet mountains.
登山客應穿著能在寒冷潮濕的山上保持乾爽溫暖的機能服飾。
